summary: YPF S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting a board change. The Board accepted the resignation of Class D Regular Director Maximiliano D'Alessio for strictly personal reasons, effective September 7, 2026. The Supervisory Committee for Class D shares appointed Martín de los Ríos Plaza as Regular Director for Class D shares to replace him, serving until the next Shareholders' Meeting. This is a routine director resignation and replacement, not an abrupt C-suite departure, so it does not meet the threshold for a special-situation event. No deal terms, advisors, or strategic implications were mentioned.
